name: flakeradar
description: Self-hosted flaky test detection for CI: ingests JUnit reports, scores every test for flakiness and comments on pull requests.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @flakeradar/core && npm run build -w @flakeradar/server && npm run build -w @flakeradar/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @flakeradar/core && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @flakeradar/server" "npm run dev -w @flakeradar/web"
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @flakeradar/core && npm run seed -w @flakeradar/server
scripts.build:demo: npm run build -w @flakeradar/core && npm run export-demo -w @flakeradar/server && npm run build:demo -w @flakeradar/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @flakeradar/core && npm run test -w @flakeradar/core && npm run test -w @flakeradar/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @flakeradar/core && npm run typecheck -w @flakeradar/server && npm run typecheck -w @flakeradar/web
